text: I feel a quiet excitement here—a sense of anticipation that accompanies spaces devoted to discovery and contemplation. The modern aesthetic and the emphasis on research and development invite me to ponder the relentless quest for knowledge. I am keenly aware of my own presence, a thinker among artifacts, surrounded by the momentum of innovation and the silent hum of ideas exchanging energy just as molecules do in the crisp air. My curiosity stirs, mingled with a dash of awe and humility at the vastness of what I do not know.
